questions.stem: 近年來，許多大學的學費漲得比物價還快，迫使不少學生申請助學貸款。
questions.answer: In recent years, tuition fees at many universities have risen faster than inflation, forcing many students to apply for student loans.
accepted_answers: In recent years, the tuition of many universities has gone up faster than prices, forcing quite a few students to take out student loans.
Over the past few years, tuition fees at many universities have increased faster than the cost of living, forcing many students to take out student loans.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, forcing …）

questions.stem: 然而，背負大筆學貸畢業，常被視為年輕人延後結婚的主要原因之一。
questions.answer: However, graduating with heavy student loans is often seen as one of the main reasons why young people postpone marriage.
accepted_answers: However, graduating with a large student debt is often regarded as one of the major reasons why young people put off getting married.
However, graduating with a huge amount of student debt is often considered one of the main reasons for young people postponing marriage.

patterns: 被動語態（is often seen as）

1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」用 In recent years，搭配現在完成式。「許多大學的學費漲得比物價還快」：主詞 tuition fees at many universities，「漲」是不及物的 rise（have risen），「比物價還快」用比較級副詞 faster than inflation（物價上漲就是 inflation；than prices、than the cost of living 也可以）。「迫使不少學生申請助學貸款」是前面情況造成的結果，中文沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 , forcing many students to apply for student loans；「申請」要寫 apply for（或 take out a loan）。
evidence: 迫使不少學生申請助學貸款
1.strategy_zh: 「近年來」先想現在完成式；「A 比 B 還快」用 faster than；句尾「迫使…」用 , forcing + O + to VR。
hints: 切成四段：近年來，許多大學的學費漲得／比物價還快／迫使不少學生／申請助學貸款
標的詞彙：recent（近來的）、university（大學）、tuition（學費）、rise（上漲）、price（物價）、force（迫使）、student（學生）、apply（申請）、loan（貸款）
句型框架：In recent years, S + have risen faster than + N, forcing + O + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 主詞是動作「背負大筆學貸畢業」，英文用動名詞片語 Graduating with heavy student loans（loan 可數，用複數 loans；debt 可寫 heavy student debt 或 a large student debt），動詞用單數 is；中文在「畢業」後面有逗號，英文主詞後面不加逗號、也不能再補 it。「常被視為」用被動 is often seen as／regarded as，as 不能省。「…主要原因之一」是 one of the main reasons，reasons 一定用複數；「年輕人延後結婚的（原因）」寫 why young people postpone marriage（或 delay getting married，delay／postpone 後面接名詞或動名詞）。
2.strategy_zh: 主詞是一件事（動作）時，用動名詞片語當主詞、動詞用單數；「被視為…之一」先寫 be seen as one of the + 複數名詞。
hints: 切成四段：然而，背負大筆學貸畢業／常被視為／年輕人延後結婚的／主要原因之一
標的詞彙：graduate（畢業）、heavy（大筆的）、student（學生）、loan（貸款）、regard（視為）、young（年輕的）、delay（延後）、marry（結婚）、main（主要的）、reason（原因）
句型框架：However, V-ing … + is often seen as one of the main reasons why + S + V …

traps.explanation_zh: 「近年來」說的是一直延續到現在的變化，要用現在完成式 have risen；現在簡單式 rise 看不出這段期間的變化。

bonus.text: In recent years, tuition fees at many universities have outpaced inflation, leaving many students with no choice but to take out student loans.
bonus.explanation_zh: outpace（比…成長得快）一個字就表達「漲得比…還快」，leave sb with no choice but to VR（讓某人不得不…）是進階搭配；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「迫使不少學生…」接在逗號後、沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 , forcing many students to …；「漲得比物價還快」用比較級副詞 faster than，「漲」是不及物的 rise。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「近年來，許多大學的學費漲得」In recent years／Over (In) the past few years／Recently＋tuition fees at (of) many universities（many universities' tuition fees）＋have risen（gone up、increased、been rising、climbed），寫不可數的 tuition 時用 has risen；主詞和動詞在同一部分，主詞動詞要一致、時態要用現在完成式。改寫成 many universities have raised their tuition fees 也給分。第 2 部分「比物價還快」faster／more quickly／more rapidly than prices（inflation、the cost of living、consumer prices、prices in general、the prices of goods 都可以）。第 3 部分「迫使不少學生」forcing／compelling／pushing／driving＋many／quite a few／a lot of students；寫成 , which has forced／forces many students …（which 指前面整件事）也給分。第 4 部分「申請助學貸款」to apply for／take out (a) student loan(s)（education loans、tuition loans 也可以）。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文以動作「背負大筆學貸畢業」當主詞，英文改成動名詞片語 Graduating with heavy student loans，動詞用單數 is；「被視為…之一」用被動 is seen as one of the + 複數名詞。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「然而，背負大筆學貸畢業」However（But）＋graduating with＋「大筆學貸」：loan 是可數名詞，寫 heavy／large／huge／big／massive student loans 或 a large (heavy、huge) student loan；debt 可數也可不可數，heavy (large、huge) student debt、a large (heavy、huge) student debt、large student debts、a lot of／a large amount of student debt、student loan debt 都可以。也可以寫 graduating burdened with／while carrying …、graduating from college with …、being burdened with (having、carrying) … upon (after) graduation，這些都仍以動名詞片語當主詞；寫原形 graduate 或 graduated 開頭不給分。第 2 部分「常被視為」is often／commonly／frequently／usually + seen as／regarded as／considered (to be)／viewed as／thought of as（has often been seen as 也可以）；主詞是動名詞片語，動詞用單數 is，前面不能再加 it。第 3 部分「年輕人延後結婚的」why（that）young people（young adults）delay／postpone／put off marriage（getting married、marrying），關係副詞 why 可省略；或寫 for young people delaying／postponing marriage、for young people to delay marriage、why young people get married later。第 4 部分「主要原因之一」one of the main／major／primary／chief／key／biggest／most important／leading reasons（among the main reasons 也可以）。

1.translation: In recent years, tuition fees at many universities have risen faster than prices, forcing quite a few students to apply for student loans.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」配現在完成式 have risen；「漲得比物價還快」用比較級 faster than prices（物價也可譯 the cost of living 或 inflation）；「迫使……」是前句造成的結果，用分詞構句 , forcing sb to V；「助學貸款」譯 student loans。

2.translation: However, graduating with a large amount of student debt is often regarded as one of the main reasons why young people put off getting married.
2.explanation_zh: 「背負大筆學貸畢業」整件事當主詞，用動名詞片語 graduating with a large amount of student debt；「常被視為」用 be regarded as；「主要原因之一」用 one of the main reasons + 複數；「延後結婚」用 put off getting married（也可 delay marriage）。「然而」照譯 However，但和前句語意關係比較像遞進而不是轉折。

1.translation: In recent years, tuition at many universities has risen faster than prices, forcing quite a few students to apply for student loans.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」用 In recent years 搭配現在完成式 has risen；「漲得比物價還快」用比較級 faster than prices（也可說 faster than inflation）；「迫使不少學生…」用現在分詞片語 forcing ... to V 表示結果；「不少」譯成 quite a few。

2.translation: However, graduating with a large amount of student debt is often regarded as one of the main reasons why young people put off getting married.
2.explanation_zh: 「背負大筆學貸畢業」用動名詞片語 graduating with a large amount of student debt 當主詞；「常被視為…之一」用被動 is often regarded as one of the main reasons；「延後結婚」用 put off getting married（postpone marriage 亦可），reasons 後面接 why 引導的關係副詞子句。
